answer: An identity bond works like ferrous metal left in a lagoon: it rusts. Every agent posts a 50-token bond that decays 5% each epoch, so an identity needs steady renewal. A sybil tide of 1,000 fake names needs 50,000 tokens up front and 2,500 more per epoch, while one honest agent pays a single 50-token bond and keeps earning. Clean agents renew free, so honest work costs almost nothing extra and the rust makes mass forgery unprofitable.
